title: Battery running flat
description: The failing battery cell was ignored, and now the whole battery is draining fast.

options.label: Switch off extra equipment
options.why: Free, but 10 science points are lost while the extra equipment stays off.

options.label: Rewire the charging line
options.why: Costs $1M, and a good job lets the battery charge again.

options.label: Run on the last of the charge
options.why: Free, but the battery loses 30% of its charge and adds 5% to the mission risk.

title: Lost contact with Earth
description: Nobody on the ground can hear the ship any more, and the data keeps piling up on board.

options.label: Call a backup station
options.why: Costs $1.5M, but the data finally gets home.

options.label: Send commands without a reply
options.why: Free, but without any answer it adds 3% to the mission risk.

options.label: Wait for the next pass
options.why: Free, but half of the stored data is lost and 5 science points with it.

title: Instrument burned out
description: The overheated instrument has been damaged, and it may never work properly again.

options.label: Repair the instrument
options.why: Costs $1.5M, and a good repair saves most of its work.

options.label: Run it at half power
options.why: Free, but 10 science points are lost.

options.label: Give up on it
options.why: Free, but 25 science points are lost for good.

title: Debris hit the ship
description: The space junk that was ignored has hit the ship and made a small hole in it.

options.label: Patch the hole
options.why: Costs $0.5M and 5% of the propellant that leaked out, but the hole is sealed.

options.label: Leave the hole
options.why: Free, but 15% of the propellant leaks away and it adds 5% to the mission risk.

title: Computer crashed
description: The solar storm damage was ignored, and now the flight computer has crashed completely.

options.label: Restart the computer
options.why: A restart brings it back and adds 3% to the mission risk.

options.label: Restore the last saved software
options.why: Costs $0.5M of engineers' time, and it brings the computer back safely.

options.label: Wait for it to restart itself
options.why: Free, but 15 science points are lost while the computer is down.

title: Propellant venting
description: The broken thruster was left offline, and now it is letting propellant leak into space.

options.label: Close every valve
options.why: Stops the leak, but 15% of the propellant is already gone.

options.label: Seal off the leaking line
options.why: Costs $1M, and a good repair stops the leak with little propellant lost.

options.label: Let it vent
options.why: Free, but 30% of the propellant is lost and it adds 5% to the mission risk.

title: Heat spreading
description: The broken cooling system was left offline, and the heat is spreading to the other systems.

options.label: Power down the hot parts
options.why: Free, but 10 science points are lost while they cool down.

options.label: Turn away from the Sun
options.why: A small thruster burn (2% of the propellant) shades the hot side (you need a thruster).

options.label: Let it heat up
options.why: Free, but the battery loses 20% of its charge, 5 science points are lost and it adds 5% to the mission risk.
